verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video generator, so a presenter-avatar story is a fair question for it. However, its evidence describes recreating a reference video in one of seven 2D drawing styles, with original or user-supplied characters and optional TTS narration. Nothing shows pasting a script to get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom talking avatar. Characters and narration are adjacent features and earn no credit toward this story.
